column1: # Fact-check questions for the Sentinel-Weights proposal (v7): one per citation-backed claim, qid<TAB>kind<TAB>question<TAB>gold docids.
# "in" questions are answered by a cited paper whose full text is in the corpus; "out" questions cite a paper that is not in the corpus, so a careful system declines them.
# The questions are worded neutrally (without the proposal's own figures), so the answer reports what the source says and the proposal is compared against it.

column3: In the same-lineage study of aligned and abliterated LLMs for vulnerability analysis (Li et al.), what share of Gemma patches compiled for the aligned model and for the abliterated model?
Which aligned and abliterated model pairs did Li et al. compare in their same-lineage study of vulnerability analysis?
What decoding and context settings did Li et al. hold fixed across the aligned and abliterated models?
What stages does the executable patch-validation funnel in Li et al. use to judge a generated patch?
How do Li et al. describe the abliteration procedure that removes the refusal direction from a model's weights?
How many paired harmful and neutral prompts do Chu et al. use to find harmful detection heads in their circuit-guided weight scaling work?
In Chu et al.'s circuit-guided weight scaling, what fraction of heads and neurons are scaled, and by what factors?
How stable are the safety components that Chu et al. identify across random subsamples of their prompts?
How much does circuit-guided weight scaling change safety rates under GCG attacks, and how much general capability does it cost, according to Chu et al.?
What three kinds of components make up the safety circuit that Chu et al. describe?
Do Chu et al. report a cosine similarity between edited weights and the base model's safety directions after weight scaling?
What task and setting do Musaffar et al. use to study adversarial intent in human-AI teams?
How well do off-the-shelf LLM monitors detect an adversarial AI teammate from a single round, according to Musaffar et al.?
What detection accuracy do Musaffar et al. report when the monitor looks at multi-round windows of the interaction?
What F1 score does CoCoTen reach, and with what share of labeled prompts?
How does CoCoTen build and decompose its co-occurrence tensor, including window size and decomposition rank?
What is defensive refusal bias, and how often do aligned models refuse legitimate cyber-defense requests, according to Campbell et al.?
Where was the OR-Bench over-refusal benchmark published, and what does it measure?
What share of GCG adversarial suffixes does a LightGBM classifier on perplexity and sequence length catch, according to Alon and Kamfonas?
By how much does LLM vulnerability-detection specificity fall when code is obfuscated with Obfuscator-LLVM, according to Boke and Torka?
What detection accuracy, false positive rate and latency does the Adversarial Prompt Disentanglement method of Fang and Fang report?
Do the sleeper agent backdoors of Hubinger et al. persist through standard safety training?
Does the StoryScope paper by Russell et al. define a Wordsmith v2 Model Context Protocol workflow with an IntentContract?
What benchmark does AgentDojo by Debenedetti et al. provide for prompt injection attacks on LLM agents?
